subcategory_text: Data processing ecosystem parties are routinely assessed using audits, test results, or other forms of evaluations to confirm they are meeting their contractual, interoperability framework, or other obligations.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SR-6 (Supplier Assessments and Reviews), CA-2 (Control Assessments)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.19, A.5.21 (Managing information security in the ICT supply chain)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 ID.SC-04 (suppliers prioritised) and GV.SC-08
implementation_examples: Run periodic and event-driven assessments (audits, third-party assessments, certifications) of ecosystem parties to confirm contractual and interoperability obligations are met
Track assessment findings to closure and re-test the affected obligations
Make assessment outcomes available to the parties' accountability functions
assessment_objectives: Determine whether ecosystem parties are assessed on a recurring basis
Determine whether assessments use audits, test results, or other forms of evaluation
Determine whether findings are tracked to closure
Determine whether assessment outcomes inform re-prioritisation and re-contracting
